scope: Read-only one-pass finite CPU capacity diagnostics; original classifications/results unchanged.

backlogFrozen.scope: Non-atomic queue_depth + in_flight observations; not exact queue conservation. Growth is positive OLS trend times observed span in the second half of the arrival window; drain samples excluded.

trials.scope: CSV times use the load JVM monotonic origin. UTC is approximate. API occupancy integrates execute-call intervals, not server parallelism; bins by planned arrival may contain calls executing later. No invalid point is promoted and no p99 values are subtracted.
